english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for lack of care or negligence, especially when describing what caused a mistake or accident.
This is the all-purpose choice for an act or habitual pattern of failing to give proper care or attention.

examples.english: This accident was caused by the staff's carelessness.
examples.traditional: 今次意外係由於工作人員疏忽造成嘅。

examples.english: Their neglect of the elderly caused a lot of trouble.
